# Formatter installation guide

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the formatter descriptors. Do not edit by hand. -->

CodeNeat never downloads or installs anything. Install the formatter yourself with one of the commands below, then run **CodeNeat: Re-detect Installed Formatters** (or press *Re-detect* on the Formatter Management page).

CodeNeat looks for a formatter in this order: the path you set on the Formatter Management page (`codeneat.toolPaths`), a project-local installation (trusted workspaces only), then your `PATH`.

## Prettier

- **Languages:** HTML, CSS, SCSS, Less, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, TSX, JSON, JSON with Comments, YAML, Markdown, MDX, Vue, Angular Template, GraphQL
- **Engine and licence:** Prettier — MIT
- **Needs:** Bundled with CodeNeat. A Prettier installed in your project (node_modules) is used instead when the workspace is trusted.
- **Project configuration it reads:** `.prettierrc`, `.prettierrc.json`, `.prettierrc.json5`, `.prettierrc.yaml`, `.prettierrc.yml`, `.prettierrc.toml`, `.prettierrc.js`, `.prettierrc.cjs`, `.prettierrc.mjs`, `.prettierrc.ts`, `prettier.config.js`, `prettier.config.cjs`, `prettier.config.mjs`, `prettier.config.ts`, `package.json (prettier key)`
- **Options CodeNeat can set:** Line Endings (`endOfLine`); Format Embedded Code (`embeddedLanguageFormatting`); Preferred Line Length (`printWidth`); Wrap Text Paragraphs (`proseWrap`); Multi-line Objects (`objectWrap`); One Attribute per Line (`singleAttributePerLine`); Operators When Wrapping (`experimentalOperatorPosition`); Indent Using (`useTabs`); Indentation Size (`tabWidth`); Indent <script> and <style> in Vue Files (`vueIndentScriptAndStyle`); HTML Nesting and Whitespace (`htmlWhitespaceSensitivity`); Spaces Inside Object Braces (`bracketSpacing`); Closing ">" on the Last Attribute Line (`bracketSameLine`); Parentheses Around a Single Arrow Parameter (`arrowParens`); Quotes (`singleQuote`); Quotes in JSX Attributes (`jsxSingleQuote`); Quotes Around Object Keys (`quoteProps`); Semicolons (`semi`); Trailing Commas (`trailingComma`); JavaScript: New Ternary Layout (`experimentalTernaries`)
- **Limitations:**
  - Brace position, spacing around operators and blank lines between members are fixed by Prettier and cannot be configured.
  - Quotes cannot be preserved as written.
  - Imports are never sorted or removed.
  - Angular templates are detected from the ".component.html" file name or the Angular language id.

## Prettier for Java

- **Languages:** Java
- **Engine and licence:** prettier-plugin-java (Prettier) — Apache-2.0
- **Needs:** Bundled with CodeNeat.
- **Project configuration it reads:** `.prettierrc`, `.prettierrc.json`, `.prettierrc.json5`, `.prettierrc.yaml`, `.prettierrc.yml`, `.prettierrc.toml`, `.prettierrc.js`, `.prettierrc.cjs`, `.prettierrc.mjs`, `.prettierrc.ts`, `prettier.config.js`, `prettier.config.cjs`, `prettier.config.mjs`, `prettier.config.ts`, `package.json (prettier key)`
- **Options CodeNeat can set:** Line Endings (`endOfLine`); Preferred Line Length (`printWidth`); Operators When Wrapping (`experimentalOperatorPosition`); Indent Using (`useTabs`); Indentation Size (`tabWidth`); Parentheses Around a Single Arrow Parameter (`arrowParens`); Trailing Commas (`trailingComma`)
- **Fixed by the formatter:** The Java plugin for Prettier always sorts import statements. It never adds or removes one. The Java plugin for Prettier always keeps the opening brace on the same line.
- **Limitations:**
  - Import statements are always sorted (this cannot be switched off). Unused imports are never removed.
  - Brace position is always "same line".

## Prettier for LaTeX

- **Languages:** LaTeX
- **Engine and licence:** prettier-plugin-latex (unified-latex, Prettier) — MIT
- **Needs:** Bundled with CodeNeat.
- **Project configuration it reads:** `.prettierrc`, `.prettierrc.json`, `.prettierrc.json5`, `.prettierrc.yaml`, `.prettierrc.yml`, `.prettierrc.toml`, `.prettierrc.js`, `.prettierrc.cjs`, `.prettierrc.mjs`, `.prettierrc.ts`, `prettier.config.js`, `prettier.config.cjs`, `prettier.config.mjs`, `prettier.config.ts`, `package.json (prettier key)`
- **Options CodeNeat can set:** Line Endings (`endOfLine`); Preferred Line Length (`printWidth`); Indent Using (`useTabs`); Indentation Size (`tabWidth`)
- **Limitations:**
  - This formatter re-wraps paragraphs, puts a blank line between list items and writes x^2 as x^{2}. These are equivalent in LaTeX, but the source changes more than with latexindent, which only adjusts indentation.
  - Documents that redefine category codes or use unusual macro syntax may not be understood. Preview before applying.

## SQL Formatter

- **Languages:** SQL
- **Engine and licence:** sql-formatter — MIT
- **Needs:** Bundled with CodeNeat.
- **Options CodeNeat can set:** Line Endings (`line endings are converted by CodeNeat after formatting`); Indent Using (`useTabs`); Indentation Size (`tabWidth`); Maximum Blank Lines in a Row (`linesBetweenQueries`); SQL: Dialect (`language`); SQL: Keyword Case (`keywordCase`)
- **Limitations:**
  - There is no line-length setting: every clause goes on its own line.
  - Stored-procedure bodies in vendor-specific languages are formatted on a best-effort basis; choose the matching dialect.

## Ruff (bundled)

- **Languages:** Python
- **Engine and licence:** Ruff formatter, compiled to WebAssembly (@wasm-fmt/ruff_fmt) — MIT
- **Needs:** Bundled with CodeNeat (WebAssembly build). Nothing to install.
- **Options CodeNeat can set:** Line Endings (`line endings are converted by CodeNeat after formatting`); Preferred Line Length (`line-length`); Indent Using (`format.indent-style`); Indentation Size (`indent-width`); Quotes (`format.quote-style`); Format Documentation Comments (`format.docstring-code-format`); Python: Trailing Comma Keeps Lists Expanded (`format.skip-magic-trailing-comma (inverted)`)
- **Limitations:**
  - The bundled build does not read ruff.toml or pyproject.toml. Install Ruff to have that file respected; .editorconfig and your CodeNeat preferences always apply.
  - Import sorting needs the installed Ruff; the bundled build only formats.
  - Brace and spacing rules follow the Black code style and cannot be changed.

## gofmt (bundled)

- **Languages:** Go
- **Engine and licence:** gofmt, compiled to WebAssembly (@wasm-fmt/gofmt) — BSD-3-Clause
- **Needs:** Bundled with CodeNeat (WebAssembly build). Nothing to install.
- **Options CodeNeat can set:** Line Endings (`line endings are converted by CodeNeat after formatting`)
- **Fixed by the formatter:** gofmt always indents with tabs. This is the single standard Go style. gofmt never wraps lines and has no line-length setting. Go requires the opening brace on the same line. gofmt does not change quotes.
- **Limitations:**
  - gofmt implements one standard style and has no style options at all.

## clang-format (bundled)

- **Languages:** Java, C, C++, C#, Protocol Buffers
- **Engine and licence:** clang-format (LLVM), compiled to WebAssembly (@wasm-fmt/clang-format) — Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
- **Needs:** Bundled with CodeNeat (WebAssembly build). Nothing to install.
- **Options CodeNeat can set:** Line Endings (`line endings are converted by CodeNeat after formatting`); Preferred Line Length (`ColumnLimit`); Operators When Wrapping (`BreakBeforeBinaryOperators`); Indent Using (`UseTab`); Indentation Size (`IndentWidth / TabWidth`); Continuation Indentation (`ContinuationIndentWidth`); Indent Case Labels in Switch (`IndentCaseLabels`); Wrapped Arguments in Parentheses (`AlignAfterOpenBracket`); Space Before Opening Parenthesis (`SpaceBeforeParens`); Spaces Inside Parentheses (`SpacesInParentheses`); Space Before Assignment Operators (`SpaceBeforeAssignmentOperators`); Maximum Blank Lines in a Row (`MaxEmptyLinesToKeep`); Blank Line Between Functions and Classes (`SeparateDefinitionBlocks`); Opening Brace Position (`BreakBeforeBraces`); Short Functions on One Line (`AllowShortFunctionsOnASingleLine`); Short "if" on One Line (`AllowShortIfStatementsOnASingleLine`); Sort Imports (`SortIncludes`); Re-wrap Long Comments (`ReflowComments`); C / C++: Base Style (`BasedOnStyle`)
- **Limitations:**
  - The bundled build does not read .clang-format. Install clang-format to have that file respected; .editorconfig and your CodeNeat preferences always apply.
  - The defaults shown are those of the LLVM base style; other base styles start from different values.
  - Preferences you have not set are taken from the selected base style.

- **Engine and licence:** dart_style, compiled to WebAssembly (@wasm-fmt/dart_fmt) — BSD-3-Clause
- **Needs:** Bundled with CodeNeat (WebAssembly build). Nothing to install.

- **Languages:** Java

- **Fixed by the formatter:** google-java-format always uses a 100 character line length. google-java-format always indents with spaces. Indentation is 2 spaces in Google style and 4 in AOSP style. Choose the style under "Java: Style Guide". Google Java Style puts the opening brace on the same line.
- **Limitations:**
  - Implements the Google Java Style Guide; only the Google/AOSP switch and import handling can be configured.

## CSharpier

- **Languages:** C#
- **Engine and licence:** CSharpier — MIT
- **Needs:** The "csharpier" .NET tool (needs the .NET SDK).
- **Looks for:** `csharpier`, `dotnet-csharpier`
- **Install:** Install CSharpier as a .NET global tool.

- **Project configuration it reads:** `.csharpierrc`, `.csharpierrc.json`, `.csharpierrc.yaml`, `.csharpierrc.yml`
- **Options CodeNeat can set:** Line Endings (`line endings are converted by CodeNeat after formatting`); Preferred Line Length (`printWidth`); Indent Using (`useTabs`); Indentation Size (`indentSize`)

## Fantomas

- **Languages:** F#
- **Engine and licence:** Fantomas — Apache-2.0
- **Needs:** The "fantomas" .NET tool (needs the .NET SDK).
- **Looks for:** `fantomas`
- **Install:** Install Fantomas as a .NET global tool.
  - .NET: `dotnet tool install -g fantomas`
- **Guide:** https://fsprojects.github.io/fantomas/docs/end-users/GettingStarted.html

## PHP-CS-Fixer

- **Languages:** PHP
- **Engine and licence:** PHP-CS-Fixer — MIT
- **Needs:** The "php-cs-fixer" executable (needs PHP).
- **Looks for:** `php-cs-fixer`
- **Install:** Install PHP-CS-Fixer with Composer or Homebrew.

## ktfmt

- **Limitations:**
